scope: PXA2-033 modular component and surface selector consolidation
required_layer_order: @layer px.legacy, px.tokens, px.primitives, px.layout, px.components, px.surfaces, px.responsive, px.accessibility;
policy: Duplicates are compared within the same unscoped, media, supports, or container context. Cross-layer selector duplication is prohibited; remaining same-file compatibility rules may only decrease until fully consolidated.
